description: A curated vocabulary for the committed Northwind snapshot. Property types describe the values actually retained in the source export.

Customer.description: A customer account, represented by a company in this dataset.
Customer.label: Customer

Order.description: A purchase order placed by a customer.
Order.label: Order
Order.titleMeaning: The order identifier used as a display title.

Product.description: An item that can occur in an order and be supplied by a supplier.
Product.label: Product

Category.description: A classification used to group products.
Category.label: Category

PURCHASED.description: A customer placed an order. This relationship connects a customer to an order, not directly to a product.
PURCHASED.label: placed order

ORDERS.description: An order includes a product. Line-item values are properties of this relationship.
ORDERS.label: includes product

quantity.description: The ordered quantity recorded on this order-product relationship.

unitPrice.description: The line-item unit price as a decimal string in the source export.

discount.description: The discount as a decimal string in the source export.

productID.description: The original product identifier repeated on the source order line.

orderID.description: The original order identifier repeated on the source order line.

PART_OF.description: A product belongs to a product category. This relation is not declared transitive.
PART_OF.label: belongs to category
